notes: Annual cash balance change must be decomposed into contributor count payroll contribution-rate pensioner count average-benefit transfer and residual components before attributing deterioration
Closure should mechanically reduce new entrant inflows but annual contributor counts are not registered
Average contribution and wage-base effects cannot be computed without payroll bases
Policy-rate changes must be separated from demographic closure effects before decomposition
Pensioner and survivor count changes cannot be separated with current processed evidence
Average benefit effects require pension expenditure and recipient counts
Transfer effects must be separated from contribution and benefit drivers
Any residual remains an accounting gap and cannot be interpreted as historical underfunding without reconciled components
